describe.description: The creature is a stout, quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing three-quarter view standing on a small patch of bare earth with sparse green tufts and dry leaves. Its body is low and broad with a pale, transversely ridged underbelly and a dorsal surface, including the top of the head and the entire tail, covered in overlapping rounded brown-gray scales with darker centers and lighter edges. The head is broad, flat and blunt-snouted with large protruding eyes that have golden-brown irises and dark pupils, small round nostrils near the snout tip, and a straight, slightly upturned mouth. Six feathery external gills with dark stalks and dense reddish frills project from the sides of the head and neck, three per side. The limbs are thick, wrinkled and pale gray-brown, ending in splayed five-toed feet with dark claws. The tail is long, broad, flattened and paddle-shaped, tapering to a rounded tip and covered above in the same overlapping scales as the back.
